reason: In misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:153-158, `santizeAnchors` advances the translation and English matchers in lockstep and requires the i-th tags to be equal, so a translation that reorders two different links gets "Didn't find anchor tag". ANCHOR_PATTERN at line 145 is `</?a[^>]*>` with no boundary after `a`, so it also matches `<abbr>`, `<area>` and `<audio>`.
